snippet.title: A boy and his blob - The rescue of princess Blobette (part 1)
snippet.description:
I recovered this very old game for GameBoy. I remebered playing this long time ago. I never came very far. You will see why. The control is not very good. But the idea with these different tools for getting through is nice. I hope for a remake with better graphics and better control.
Btw.: Sometimes the game "lacks" (everything slow and the boy is blinking)
